title: DSA in Python
description: Classic data structures and algorithms implemented in Python, from arrays and hashing through trees and dynamic programming.
longDescription:
## Data Structures & Algorithms in Python

Work through the most common interview-style DSA topics using Python. Each pack focuses on a category of problems with multiple solution approaches.

### Topics covered

- Arrays, hashing, and sliding window techniques
- Two-pointer and string manipulation patterns
- Linked list traversal, reversal, and cycle detection
- Binary trees: traversal, depth, paths, and construction
- Binary search, dynamic programming, and bit manipulation
